title: Aadhaar & PAN Card Assistance
description: Guidance and submission assistance for new PAN card applications, PAN corrections, and Aadhaar document update verification. Note: Final approval and dispatch are managed directly by authorized government authorities.
documents: Passport size photos
Valid proof of identity (School LC, Voter ID)
Proof of address (Electricity bill, Ration card)
Active mobile number linked with Aadhaar
process: Document verification at institute -> Online application submission -> Receipt generated -> Track delivery status

title: Voter ID Card & Passport Appointment
description: Assistance with online registration of new Voter ID cards (Form 6), address corrections, digital voter ID download, and Passport Seva portal application filling and appointment booking.
documents: Age proof (Birth Certificate or 10th Marksheet)
Address proof & family voter details
Passport: Original Educational documents, Aadhaar, PAN
process: Fill application on portal -> Upload necessary documents -> Schedule appointment (for Passport) or generate submission receipt

title: Income, Domicile & Caste Certificate Guidance
description: Digital facilitation for citizen certificates through the Aaple Sarkar portal. We assist citizens with correct documentation, gazette declarations, and affidavit verification before online portal submission.
documents: Applicant Aadhaar card & Ration card
Income proof (Talathi / Tahsildar report or Form 16)
School Leaving Certificate (LC) showing birth place for Domicile
Father's / Relative's School LC & Caste proof for Caste Certificate
process: Compile attested documents -> Upload via citizen portal -> Application submission tracking -> Digital certificate download on approval

title: 7/12 & 8A Land Record Digital Downloads
description: Quick download and printing of digitally signed 7/12 (Satbara), 8A Utara, and Ferfar land revenue records directly from Maharashtra Mahabhulekh / Mahabhumi portals.
documents: Village name, Taluka, and District (e.g. Kurkumbh / Daund / Pune)
Survey / Gut number or Khata number
process: Verify Gut number -> Search record on portal -> Generate official digitally signed copy -> High-quality printout

title: MahaDBT Scholarship & Fee Reimbursement
description: End-to-end guidance for college and school students applying for Social Justice, Tribal, Minority, and EBC scholarships on the Maharashtra MahaDBT portal.
documents: Current college admission receipt & allotment letter
Previous year marksheet
Income certificate (valid for current academic year)
Caste / Domicile certificate (if applicable)
Aadhaar-seeded bank passbook copy
process: Profile creation & course registration -> Document upload -> Verification with college nodal desk -> Tracking fund disbursement

title: Exam Forms, Hall Tickets & Recruitment Applications
description: Assistance for online application forms for competitive exams (MPSC, UPSC, Police Bharti, Talathi, ZP, Army, Banking, SSC, Railway) and board/university examination form submission.
documents: Educational qualification certificates & marksheets
Passport photo and signature as per prescribed size/DPI
Caste / Non-Creamy Layer certificate (if applying under quota)
Valid email ID and active mobile number
process: Review notification guidelines -> Accurate form entry -> Photo/signature resizing -> Online fee payment -> Print confirmation page

title: Udyam (MSME) & Basic Food License (FSSAI)
description: Guidance for micro and small businesses, shops, and traders in Kurkumbh and Daund taluka to obtain Udyam registration certificates and basic FSSAI registrations.
documents: Business owner Aadhaar and PAN card
Business name, address, and bank account details
Nature of business / service activities
process: Registration on official MSME portal -> Mobile OTP verification -> Free digital certificate issuance

title: PM Kisan eKYC & Farmer Scheme Assistance
description: Assistance for local farmers with biometric/OTP-based eKYC for PM Kisan Samman Nidhi, registration for crop insurance (Pik Vima), and status verification.
documents: Farmer Aadhaar Card
Land record (7/12) and bank passbook
Registered mobile number
process: Biometric or OTP authentication -> Instant verification on portal -> Print status acknowledgment

title: Printing, Lamination, Scanning & Utility Payments
description: High-speed black & white and color laser printing, large document scanning, PDF compilation, PVC smart card printing, and electricity / utility bill payment processing.
documents: Softcopy via WhatsApp / Email / USB drive
Physical documents for Xerox or scanning
process: Immediate counter service with clean output and clear receipts
